notes: Far north: Masoala and Marojejy rainforest (Helmet Vanga, Nuthatch Vanga, Bernier's Vanga, Red-breasted Coua, Madagascar Red Owl), Montagne d'Ambre (Amber Mountain Rock Thrush) and the sea birds of the Nosy Be and Diego Suarez boat trips. Mangrove Little Heron and White-throated Rail sit here too. Hand-picked, because the model scores these birds near 0; ranges are set from memory and eBird province lists. Van Dam's Vanga is in the country trip (it also lives at Ankarafantsika). Left out for lack of usable photos: Madagascar Serpent-Eagle and Roseate Tern.
